newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares largely flat, few impulses.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares largely flat, few impulses.

text.p: Norwegian shares were largely flat in lacklustre trade on Monday with the Total share index rising 0.27 percent to 843.05 points in turnover of 520 million crowns.

"It has been very boring," one dealer said. "We had expected a bit more activity following the release of the U.S. figures last Friday, but I think the Morgan Grenfell affair still has a crippling influence on the Norwegian market."
"Foreign investors are staying away," another said. "The Norwegian market is becoming a bit too uncertain. There are no impulses."
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro was the most traded share of the session at 53 million crowns and closed 0.16 percent higher at 305.50 crowns.

Offshore and construction company Aker still attracted trade on speculation that surfaced last week about a possible merger with the RGI investment group, its main shareholder. Aker climbed 1.89 percent to 135 crowns in 42 million crowns of trade.
